podcast.body: Led Zeppelin was persuaded to license their song "Rock and Roll" for a series of advertisements by Cadillac. This marked a significant commercial venture for the band. "Even Led Zeppelin was persuaded to license the song Rock and Roll to Cadillac for a series of ads."
